title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
caption:
New research suggests that sleep disorders are tied to physical differences in the brain. By analyzing 57 studies, scientists found that sleep issues impact the exact areas used for decision-making and focus.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261104012303.htm

Written in our own words. Credit for the research belongs to the study authors and their institution.
